title: A character model joins the lineup
summary:
A roleplay model and copyable API examples lead the day, alongside two community apps and some less-visible response fixes.

Added `qwen-character`, an alpha text model tuned to stay in character during roleplay. The unstable `flux-2-dev` was removed from the image model registry and routing.

Play’s Integrate section now builds copyable image, text, and audio GET URLs from the selected model and prompt. The standalone Docs page was removed, and `/docs` now redirects to `/play`.

The showcase added Korpi.AI, which generates AI stories with Flux, and Sage, a Discord bot with assistant features and server utilities.

daily.text: Try `qwen-character`, an alpha text model for roleplay that aims to keep replies in character. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen-character).

daily.text: Choose a model and prompt in Play, then copy a ready-to-edit GET URL for image, text, or audio generation. [Open Play](https://pollinations.ai/play).
